title: Four repos, one system
caption: Static websites on Hostinger and GitHub Pages; the backend is ready to deploy, planned on Render and Neon, with automated deploy as the next step.

visitor.label: Business owner
visitor.note: Almost always arrives on a phone and sees their industry working in a demo.

web.label: Eclipse-Web
web.note: One codebase, two builds: the demo, on local data, and the connected one, on the same domain as the API.

api.label: Eclipse-be API
api.note: Clients and administrators have separate keys, audiences and sessions. Administrators exist only in the server's environment.

db.label: PostgreSQL
db.note: Every project is born with a collected deposit: a trigger requires it when the transaction commits.

mail.label: Emails
mail.note: Stored encrypted and attempted once. The interface tracks them up to «accepted by SMTP».

ops.label: Operations
ops.note: One person: me. I sign in to the internal portal with a password and a TOTP code.

internal.label: Internal portal
internal.note: Requests, projects, prospects, calendar, communications and documents, in plain HTML and JavaScript, with a demo mode and a connected mode.

kit.label: Email kit
kit.note: A local compiler of proposal emails, in HTML and plain text. It is a prototype and I'm redoing it.
